The *"illumined divines"* are the learned men Bahá'u'lláh names in the Kitáb-i-Íqán as having attained the presence of the Báb. He introduces the list this way:

> "In this most resplendent Dispensation, however, this most mighty Sovereignty, a number of illumined divines, of men of consummate learning, of doctors of mature wisdom, have attained unto His Court… We will mention the names of some of them, that perchance it may strengthen the faint-hearted, and encourage the timorous." ([The Kitáb-i-Íqán](https://oceanlibrary.com/kitab-i-iqan_bahaullah/?paraId=para_259&selectionString=kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_9z.0~kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_9z.425))

The names that follow in the Íqán, with the Báb's Letter of the Living Mullá Ḥusayn and Siyyid Yaḥyá (Vaḥíd) named just before them ([The Kitáb-i-Íqán](https://oceanlibrary.com/kitab-i-iqan_bahaullah/?paraId=para_260&selectionString=kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.0~kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.585)), are:

1. Mullá Ḥusayn, named just before the list ([The Kitáb-i-Íqán](https://oceanlibrary.com/kitab-i-iqan_bahaullah/?paraId=para_260&selectionString=kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.0~kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.585))
2. Siyyid Yaḥyá-i-Dárábí (Vaḥíd), *"that unique and peerless figure of his age"* ([The Kitáb-i-Íqán](https://oceanlibrary.com/kitab-i-iqan_bahaullah/?paraId=para_260&selectionString=kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.0~kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.585))
3. Mullá Muḥammad-‘Alíy-i-Zanjání (Ḥujjat) ([The Kitáb-i-Íqán](https://oceanlibrary.com/kitab-i-iqan_bahaullah/?paraId=para_260&selectionString=kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.0~kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.585))
4. Mullá ‘Alíy-i-Basṭámí ([The Kitáb-i-Íqán](https://oceanlibrary.com/kitab-i-iqan_bahaullah/?paraId=para_260&selectionString=kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.0~kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.585))
5. Mullá Sa‘íd-i-Bárfurúshí ([The Kitáb-i-Íqán](https://oceanlibrary.com/kitab-i-iqan_bahaullah/?paraId=para_260&selectionString=kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.0~kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.585))
6. Mullá Ni‘matu'lláh-i-Mázindarání ([The Kitáb-i-Íqán](https://oceanlibrary.com/kitab-i-iqan_bahaullah/?paraId=para_260&selectionString=kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.0~kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.585))
7. Mullá Yúsuf-i-Ardibílí ([The Kitáb-i-Íqán](https://oceanlibrary.com/kitab-i-iqan_bahaullah/?paraId=para_260&selectionString=kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.0~kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.585))
8. Mullá Mihdíy-i-Khú'í ([The Kitáb-i-Íqán](https://oceanlibrary.com/kitab-i-iqan_bahaullah/?paraId=para_260&selectionString=kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.0~kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.585))
9. Siyyid Ḥusayn-i-Turshízí ([The Kitáb-i-Íqán](https://oceanlibrary.com/kitab-i-iqan_bahaullah/?paraId=para_260&selectionString=kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.0~kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.585))
10. Mullá Mihdíy-i-Kandí ([The Kitáb-i-Íqán](https://oceanlibrary.com/kitab-i-iqan_bahaullah/?paraId=para_260&selectionString=kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.0~kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.585))
11. Mullá Báqir ([The Kitáb-i-Íqán](https://oceanlibrary.com/kitab-i-iqan_bahaullah/?paraId=para_260&selectionString=kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.0~kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.585))
12. Mullá ‘Abdu'l-Khálíq-i-Yazdí ([Kutob 03 1 2 (notes)](https://oceanoflights.org/file/bab-kutob-03-1-2-en-notes.pdf))
13. Mullá ‘Alíy-i-Baraqání ([Kutob 03 1 2 (notes)](https://oceanoflights.org/file/bab-kutob-03-1-2-en-notes.pdf))

Bahá'u'lláh adds *"and others, well nigh four hundred in number, whose names are all inscribed upon the 'Guarded Tablet' of God."* ([Kutob 03 1 2 (notes)](https://oceanoflights.org/file/bab-kutob-03-1-2-en-notes.pdf))

Of these, the Íqán's own notes and Shoghi Effendi's writings identify the following:

- **Mullá Muḥammad-‘Alíy-i-Zanjání** was surnamed Ḥujjat. Shoghi Effendi calls him *"another famous advocate of the Cause of the Báb, even fiercer in zeal than Vaḥíd, and almost as eminent in rank."* ([God Passes By](https://oceanlibrary.com/god-passes-by_shoghi-effendi/?paraId=para_42&selectionString=god_passes_by_ocean_en_3x.0~god_passes_by_ocean_en_3x.897))
- **Siyyid Yaḥyá-i-Dárábí** was surnamed Vaḥíd. The Shah sent him to investigate the Báb's claims, and he was *"one of the most erudite, eloquent and influential of his subjects — a man who had committed to memory no less than thirty thousand traditions."* ([God Passes By](https://oceanlibrary.com/god-passes-by_shoghi-effendi/?paraId=para_41&selectionString=god_passes_by_ocean_en_3w.0~god_passes_by_ocean_en_3w.1628))
- **Mullá ‘Alíy-i-Basṭámí** was one of the Letters of the Living, *"the first to leave the House of God (Shíráz) and the first to suffer for His sake."* ([God Passes By](https://oceanlibrary.com/god-passes-by_shoghi-effendi/?paraId=para_39&selectionString=god_passes_by_ocean_en_3u.0~god_passes_by_ocean_en_3u.1230)) He was denounced as a heretic after proclaiming the Báb before Shaykh Muḥammad-Ḥasan in Najaf, and was then tried, transported to Istanbul and condemned to hard labour. ([The Kitáb-i-Aqdas](https://oceanlibrary.com/kitab-i-aqdas_bahaullah))
- **Mullá Yúsuf-i-Ardibílí** was a Letter of the Living, *"noted for his learning, his enthusiasm and eloquence."* ([The Dawn-Breakers](https://oceanlibrary.com/dawn-breakers_nabil/?paraId=para_1404&selectionString=dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_15p.0~dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_15p.75))
- **Mullá Ni‘matu'lláh-i-Mázindarání** was a Bábí believer martyred at Shaykh Ṭabarsí. ([Libro de Certeza](https://bahai-library.com/bahaullah_libro_certeza_iqan&chapter=all))
- **Mullá Mihdíy-i-Khú'í** was a close companion of Bahá'u'lláh and a teacher of the children of His household. He was martyred at Ṭabarsí. ([Libro de Certeza](https://bahai-library.com/bahaullah_libro_certeza_iqan&chapter=all))
- **Siyyid Ḥusayn-i-Turshízí** was a mujtahid from Turshíz in Khurásán, *"highly esteemed for his piety and rectitude of conduct,"* ([The Dawn-Breakers](https://oceanlibrary.com/dawn-breakers_nabil/?paraId=para_1404&selectionString=dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_15p.0~dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_15p.75)) who had studied for years in Najaf. ([The Dawn-Breakers](https://oceanlibrary.com/dawn-breakers_nabil/?paraId=para_1404&selectionString=dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_15p.0~dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_15p.75))
- **Mullá Mihdíy-i-Kandí** was a close companion of Bahá'u'lláh and a tutor to the children of His household. ([The Dawn-Breakers](https://oceanlibrary.com/dawn-breakers_nabil/?paraId=para_1404&selectionString=dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_15p.0~dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_15p.75))
- **Mullá Báqir** was the brother of Mullá Mihdíy-i-Kandí and was martyred at Ṭabarsí. ([Libro de Certeza](https://bahai-library.com/bahaullah_libro_certeza_iqan&chapter=all)) Nabíl describes the two brothers together in the fort. ([The Dawn-Breakers](https://oceanlibrary.com/dawn-breakers_nabil/?paraId=para_1404&selectionString=dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_15p.0~dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_15p.75))
- **Mullá ‘Abdu'l-Khálíq-i-Yazdí** was first a Jewish priest, then accepted Islám and joined the Shaykhí school, and was converted to the Bábí Faith by Mullá Ḥusayn. ([Libro de Certeza](https://bahai-library.com/bahaullah_libro_certeza_iqan&chapter=all))
- **Mullá ‘Alíy-i-Baraqání** was an uncle of Ṭáhirih and one of the most learned and famous Shaykhís. After accepting the Báb he became one of the most active and capable Bábí expositors in Tihrán. ([Libro de Certeza](https://bahai-library.com/bahaullah_libro_certeza_iqan&chapter=all))

I found no identifying passage in the library for Mullá Sa‘íd-i-Bárfurúshí.

Bahá'u'lláh closes the list by saying that most of them gave up their possessions and kindred and laid down their lives for the Beloved. ([The Kitáb-i-Íqán](https://oceanlibrary.com/kitab-i-iqan_bahaullah/?paraId=para_261&selectionString=kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a1.0~kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a1.1058))
